Thanks again for the call yesterday. As promised, attaching our updated listing fee invoice and a redlined terms doc for the Google Cloud Marketplace program. Highlights: 

- One-time listing fee: $18,000 (new SKU for marketplace listing + curated tile).

2) All credits/rebates that are firm vs. contingent (e.g., co-marketing vs. co-sell that requires pipeline proof).

Subject: Re: GCP listing fee update + proposed marketing credits (Q2)

Neha / Priya — pulled a quick reconciliation against our current commitments. Summary (high level):

- GCP: proposed one-time listing fee $18,000; firm marketing credit offered $6,500 (GCP indicated they can convert up to $6k of the fee into credits on approval). Co-sell rebate is contingent on joint pipeline (expected ~3-6% of net new contracted revenue, not an immediate cash offset).
- AWS: current listing fee (renewal in May) is $22,000; we have a $5k marketing credit that is already scheduled for Q3 activity. AWS will not convert the listing fee to credit, but they allow a 30-day invoice deferred payment on approved requests.
- Azure: no immediate fee this quarter (we are in a pilot tile program) but there is potential program upgrade cost in Q3 (~$9k) if we expand the tile.

Net near-term cash if we pay full fees now: ~$40k across vendors. Net immediate credits we can count on: ~$11.5k (part firm, part contingent).

Recommendation: Ask GCP to convert $6k of the listing fee into a credit that posts to our marketplace account and defer the remaining $12k for 60 days (or net-30 with an agreed MOU). For AWS, request a 30-day deferral and push marketing dollars into co-marketing activities that can be invoiced against AWS credits. This reduces Q2 cash by ~50% and keeps marketing activity intact.

I've attached a quick calc (marketplace_rebate_calc.csv) and a draft line to include in an MOU to propose a staged credit conversion to GCP. If Procurement signs off, I can push this through my partner contact and draft the MOU for signatures.

Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: marketplace_rebate_calc.csv

Looping in final confirmation from GTM: we meet the co-sell eligibility criteria based on our recent pipeline and the joint demo series we committed to. Good news — that means the contingent rebate is very likely (probability ~80%), though the timing is tied to closed-won events over the next 90 days.

For procurement action: I recommend we accept the GCP offer under these terms:

- Convert $6,000 of the $18,000 listing fee into immediate marketplace credit applied to our account;
- Defer remaining $12,000 for 60 days with a one-time deferred-invoice MOU;
- For AWS, request net-30 on the May renewal and apply $5k credit to our Q3 co-marketing plan.

If procurement (Neha) can approve the conversion + deferral, I will confirm with Priya and get the signed MOU in place. Please approve by EOD Wednesday 4/7 so we can lock Q2 budgets.
